recap.text:
Aiden Ng Leads Newport Select Gold 14U Past Hazen
November 22, 2026 vs. Hazen
Aiden Ng scored 12 points to lead Newport Select Gold 14U past Hazen, 43-21, on Sunday at Bellevue College.
Newport Select Gold 14U dominated from start to finish, never trailing in the game and leading by as many as 25 points at 41-16, on their way to a victory.
Newport Select Gold 14U had a strong first half, leading 19-14 at halftime and never looked back, securing the victory. Leading 29-16, Newport Select Gold 14U went on a 12-point run to pull further away.
The second half was the best for Newport Select Gold 14U as they outscored Hazen 24-7. Newport Select Gold 14U had five assists in the half.
Newport Select Gold 14U controlled the paint, grabbing 25 rebounds. Talen Tep led the team with eight rebounds. Ng hit three threes for Newport Select Gold 14U. Newport Select Gold 14U swiped 18 steals in the game. Ng led the team with four steals. Also contributing for Newport Select Gold 14U were Charles (8 points), Tep (6 points), Harry Zhang (6 points), Kalden Sen (6 points), Aiden Shih (2 points), Deacon Chun (2 points), and Mason Huang (1 point).
Hazen were deadly from inside the paint, finishing 6-12 on twos.
